summary: Ryanair Holdings PLC filed a Form 6-K disclosing the repurchase and cancellation of 9,583 ordinary shares and 241,998 American Depositary Shares (underlying shares) during June 15–19, 2026, under an existing buyback program announced May 20, 2025. No premium, price per share, or aggregate value is given; average prices per share range ~€25.57–€25.93 and for ADSs ~$30.64–$31.22. Repurchases are executed on the open market, with shares cancelled immediately. This is a routine capital return via open-market buybacks; no board recommendation or advisor is named. The only risk-arb angle is the ongoing execution against a share repurchase program.
